summary: Klamath County tower built on the site in 1955 under the Oregon Department of Forestry; later abandoned, and registers list it as gone.

facts.status_note: Abandoned after 1955 and gone, per the FFLOS register. No cited source describes what remains.

events.note: A tower was constructed on the site in 1955

evidence.supports: tower built on the site in 1955; later abandoned; now gone
evidence.quote: A tower was constructed on the site in 1955. It was later abandoned and is gone.

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry
about 14 miles northwest of Klamath Falls
list classes it as a tower and marks it gone
evidence.quote: Spence Mountain Klamath 42.36379 -121.97430 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1830, OR 553

notes_for_editor: The FFLOS page, firelookout.com and the FFLA list agree on the 1955 build, abandonment and gone status, but no source adds design, height, staffing, fires or access. A Pinkbike article (fetch returned 403) appeared in search about a Klamath Trails Alliance recreation project at Spence Mountain; it was not fetched or quoted, and it may or may not cover the lookout site. Brief record matches the sources; no corrections.
